newest.headline: Glass, capes and a cinematic replay engine

items.text: The shared cards read as glass on every Compose screen, not a flat grey rectangle.
Buttons now press: a ripple and a depressed face on the accent, Play and instance controls, plus a visible focus ring for controller and keyboard.
The character preview samples the authored cape art, and the cape textures carry real shading.
The splash island turns as one solid rock instead of a pile of loose boxes.
The account skin re-syncs every 24 hours, at startup and when a preview resolves.
Replay: a .glowreplay container, an offline simulator, a cinematic camera rig with FOV and Bezier easing, and a Compose keyframe timeline.

upcoming.headline: What is being worked on next

items.text: The replay recorder capturing the full world from BerryAPI's native world feed, not only the local player and voice peers.
BerryAPI's encrypted voice system, replacing the launcher's own relay settings.
More authored cape art and preview poses.
